content: subprocess-based isolation shares the host filesystem, network, and resources; without added OS-level tools it does not bound CPU/memory or wall-clock time. exec()-with-restricted-builtins is leaky (introspection escape via __subclasses__ reaching subprocess.Popen). Process-per-run plus explicit timeout is the realistic floor for a single-user tool; it is not a security boundary against a malicious payload, only against accidental infinite loops.
